scene_prompt: The day AFTER the village festival: adult tiny golden-headed steel-blue-backed Yorkshire Tiro sitting calmly in the village square in warm early morning sunlight, looking contentedly around at the happy traces of yesterday's community celebration: colorful bunting still strung between cottages, folded picnic tables, a few confetti pieces and flowers, neat gift baskets being put away. Peaceful reflective morning, not an active party or crowd, full dog visible, familiar terracotta-roof cream village houses. No cake, no party hat, no writing.
